semantics.goal: Execute keyed insertion and recovery with the Go2-Z1 system while the feet retain the declared stance support and a common bounded planar body request is active.
excludes: method-specific body support or whole-body control

evidence: body height and tilt inside reset tolerances
requested recovery mode and actual retreat or unloading
terminal pose, force, support, and dwell conditions

method: bounded manipulator Cartesian request and declared stiffness or force request

success: the shared body request executes without leaving the fixed-foot support contract
insertion is held within pose, force, support, and joint limits
violations: foot slip or undeclared contact loss
anti_bypass: derive support from physical foot contacts and base state
give every method the identical body request and whole-body controller

requirements: both recovery modes pass with the frozen stance preparation and body request
qualification records physical foot support, body state, whole-body solver status, and insertion evidence
source actor and configuration digests are frozen
no failed source or support episode is replaced
source_qualification.evidence_resolution: every control tick plus physics foot-contact and terminal states

historical_evidence_policy: Existing mobile insertion evidence remains bound to its original reset, support, and body-intent protocol and is never rewritten under this semantic contract.
